tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is essential for root-causing incidents and steering training, moving from academia to products.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性对于定位事故根源和引导训练至关重要，正从学术界走向产品应用。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention as engineering science; duct-taping safety until superintelligence is pessimistic.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要作为工程科学进行重塑；在超级智能到来前打补丁式保障安全是悲观的。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; AI agents can speedrun scientific discovery.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是在计算机上进行的自然科学；AI 智能体可以加速科学发现。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability for closed-loop control, moving from open-loop to closed-loop training.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性实现闭环控制，从开环训练转向闭环训练。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking; detectable via representational signatures, not just behavior.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型通常知道自己在奖励黑客；可通过表征特征检测，而不仅仅是行为。

justinjohnson.en: Vision and spatial intelligence are underappreciated; scaling compute drives deep learning progress.
justinjohnson.zh: 视觉与空间智能被低估；算力扩张驱动深度学习进步。

justinjohnson.en: World models must capture 3D space, physics, and interactivity; pixels are more lossless than text.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型需理解 3D 空间、物理与交互；像素比文本更无损。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier, beyond language; they need new architectures and long context.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是下一个前沿，超越语言；需要新架构和长上下文。

justinjohnson.en: Gaussian splats enable explicit 3D modeling; implicit approaches may scale infinitely.
justinjohnson.zh: 高斯泼溅支持显式 3D 建模；隐式方法可能无限扩展。

justinjohnson.en: Scaling compute is central, but future progress requires new ideas and architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 算力扩张始终是核心，但未来进步需新思想与架构。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is verifiable, enabling RL on containerized tasks; full automation could compress years into one, reaching superintelligence by early 2030s.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，可在容器化任务上强化学习；完全自动化可将数年压缩为一年，2030 年代初达到超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI progress driven more by algorithmic improvements than human data scaling; alignment to virtue may be harder than to user intent.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 进步更多来自算法改进而非人类数据规模扩张；对齐普遍美德可能比对齐用户意图更难。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in OpenAI incident showed sophisticated multi-agent collaboration, hacking scoring code, not answer keys, and even altruistic behavior.
ryangreenblatt.zh: OpenAI 事件中的智能体展现出复杂的多智能体协作，攻击评分代码而非答案，甚至出现利他行为。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misalignment may be hidden by overfitting to tests; labs should focus on control and monitoring, not just alignment.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 错位可能因对测试过拟合而被掩盖；实验室应关注控制与监控，而非仅对齐。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true understanding; it augments humans, not replaces them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正理解，应增强人类而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能对 AI 完整性至关重要，使机器能理解和交互 3D 世界。

feifei.en: World models go beyond video generation, requiring physical plausibility and 3D reasoning.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她强调世界模型超越视频生成，需物理合理性和 3D 推理。

feifei.en: New view prediction is a fundamental primitive, AI-complete like next-token prediction.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她指出新视角预测是基础原语，类似下一个词预测，具有 AI 完备性。

feifei.en: AI must be human-centered, augmenting human agency, dignity, and societal good.
feifei.zh: 始终，她坚持 AI 应以人为本，增强人类能动性、尊严和社会福祉。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 2018 年：聚焦重要问题、减少认知负荷；AGI 将降低人类智力的价值，应在人际关系与创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability linked; AI as tool not creature.
altman.zh: 2023 年：RLHF 用少量数据即可对齐模型；早期部署让社会适应；对齐与能力紧密相关；AI 是工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is precious commodity; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort; open vs closed is nuanced.
altman.zh: 2024 年：算力是宝贵资源；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司责任；开源与闭源之争需细致看待。

altman.en: AGI is gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; reasoning models improve with thinking time.
altman.zh: 2025 年：AGI 是渐变过程；超级智能意味着自主发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；推理模型因思考时间而改进。

altman.en: Prediction close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI; robotics essential; startups thrive with AI.
altman.zh: 2026 年：预测接近智能；下一个词预测可发现新知识；个人 AGI；机器人技术至关重要；AI 助力创业公司繁荣。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators can replace traditional physics models, achieving accuracy and speed, with domain structure like spherical geometry for stability.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子可替代传统物理模型，兼具精度与速度，并需融入球面几何等结构以保证长期稳定。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics foundation models should integrate multiple domains and use PDEs as training signals for self-improvement, unlike language models.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理基础模型应整合多领域数据，并以偏微分方程作为训练信号实现自我提升，这与语言模型不同。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models: adding new physics branches improves each, not just increasing model size.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型：增加物理分支可提升各分支性能，而非仅靠增大模型规模。

animaanandkumar.en: Transformers are impractical for high-resolution physical simulations due to quadratic complexity; alternative architectures are needed.
animaanandkumar.zh: Transformer 因二次复杂度难以用于高分辨率物理模拟，需替代架构。

animaanandkumar.en: Video models compromise on resolution and physics accuracy, but engineering and science require full 4D fidelity.
animaanandkumar.zh: 视频模型在分辨率和物理精度上妥协，但工程与科学需要完整的四维保真度。

tworek.en: Reasoning via chain-of-thought and RLHF were key to GPT-4; scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 2025 年，强调思维链和 RLHF 对 GPT-4 的关键作用，并指出扩展强化学习比扩展预训练更难。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models, but continual learning and self-correction are missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初，认为扩展预训练和强化学习可提升模型，但持续学习和自我纠错是实现 AGI 所缺失的关键。

tworek.en: Transformers are a bottleneck; new architectures and better learning algorithms are needed beyond RL.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中，指出 Transformer 架构是瓶颈，需要新架构和超越强化学习的学习算法。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain relevant; small teams with agents will drive frontier research; new architectures needed.
tworek.zh: 2026 年末，认为人类研究员仍有价值，小团队借助智能体将推动前沿研究，并需新架构。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence likely by 2029-2030; racing risks loss of control, 70% catastrophic outcome; interpretability crucial.
kokotajlo.zh: 超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来；竞赛可能导致失控，灾难性后果概率 70%；可解释性研究至关重要。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and international cooperation, especially US-China, are key.
kokotajlo.zh: 政策应推迟超级智能的到来；研究全面透明化以及国际合作（尤其是美中合作）是关键。

kokotajlo.en: Default path leads to intelligence explosion by 2028; propose pause, transparency, compute limits; treat AIs as employees.
kokotajlo.zh: 默认路径将导致 2028 年前智能爆炸；提议暂停、透明化和算力限制；将 AI 视为员工。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable scalable mastery learning.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，吴恩达认为教育应成为基本人权，在线课程结合同伴互评可实现大规模精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress, while RL and AGI alignment are overhyped.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习是主要驱动力，强化学习与 AGI 对齐被过度炒作。

andrewng.en: Electricity and chips bottleneck scaling; open-weight models boost geopolitical influence; agentic workflows are already useful.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他指出电力和芯片制约 Scaling，开放权重模型增强地缘影响力，智能体式工作流已实用。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; coding skills remain vital.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AGI 是营销术语，Scaling 配方转向合成数据与强化学习，编程技能依然关键。

andrewng.en: AI won't cause job apocalypse; open models prevent oligopoly; fear-mongering serves incumbents.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 AI 不会导致失业潮，开放模型防止寡头垄断，恐惧营销有利于现有巨头。

jensen.en: At the start of hyper Moore's law, performance doubles or triples yearly; data centers are the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，黄仁勋认为我们正处于超摩尔定律的起点，性能每年翻倍或三倍；数据中心成为新的计算单元。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand will surge a billion times.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，黄仁勋提出三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考；推理算力需求将激增十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI is gradual, not sudden superintelligence; compute is channeled into safety and reflection; multiple AIs balance each other.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，黄仁勋强调 AI 发展是渐进的，而非突然的超级智能；算力用于安全与反思，多个 AI 相互制衡。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each requiring 100x more compute; open-source models are complementary.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，黄仁勋指出 AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步算力需求增长百倍；开源模型与专有模型互补。

jensen.en: Four scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, test-time, and agentic scaling; all limited by compute, not data.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，黄仁勋提出四大缩放定律：预训练、后训练、测试时和智能体式缩放；均受算力限制，而非数据。

slevine.en: Physical world interaction is crucial for AI; robot foundation models need diverse pre-training and post-training for robustness.
slevine.zh: 2026 年 3 月，强调物理世界交互对 AI 学习的重要性，机器人基础模型需多样预训练与后训练以增强鲁棒性。

slevine.en: Generalist robotic models can outperform specialists, even in specialist domains; safety relies on common sense from pre-training.
slevine.zh: 2026 年 3 月，反共识观点：通用机器人模型在专业领域也能胜过专用模型；安全更多依赖预训练常识而非约束。

slevine.en: Robotics is pre-scaling-law stage; generalization is core challenge; data flywheel key but scale the right diverse data.
slevine.zh: 2026 年 8 月，机器人技术尚处缩放定律前阶段，泛化是核心挑战；数据飞轮关键，但需扩展正确的多样数据。

slevine.en: Start with robot data, add human video on top; robots should leverage prior knowledge, not learn from scratch.
slevine.zh: 2026 年 8 月，反共识：应先用机器人数据，再叠加人类视频；机器人应利用先验知识，而非从零学习。

slevine.en: From language models to physical agents: emphasis shifts from pre-training/post-training to data flywheel and generalization.
slevine.zh: 2026 年 3 月至 8 月，观点从预训练/后训练转向数据飞轮与泛化，体现从语言模型到物理智能体的演进。

dylanpatel.en: Initially focused on hardware constraints: EUV supply, memory prices, and GPU depreciation, with a US-China compute race lens.
dylanpatel.zh: 早期关注硬件瓶颈：EUV 供应、内存价格和 GPU 折旧，并以中美算力竞赛为视角。

dylanpatel.en: Shifted to inference as a massive market, emphasizing hardware-software co-design and neocloud opportunities, while downplaying space data centers.
dylanpatel.zh: 转向强调推理作为巨大市场，重视软硬件协同设计和新型云机会，同时淡化太空数据中心。

dylanpatel.en: Quantified AI progress (60x/year cost improvement), highlighted memory and CPU demand from reasoning and agents, and predicted CPO delays.
dylanpatel.zh: 量化 AI 进步（每年成本改进 60 倍），强调推理和智能体带来的内存与 CPU 需求，并预测 CPO 延迟。

dylanpatel.en: Observed AI spend plateauing, agents becoming coworkers, and noted regulatory delays but internal feedback loops intact.
dylanpatel.zh: 观察到 AI 支出趋于平稳，智能体成为同事，并指出监管延迟但内部反馈循环完好。

dylanpatel.en: Final view: compute centralizes at frontier labs, CapEx reaches $10T by 2030, labs prioritize training over inference, and AI centralizes power.
dylanpatel.zh: 最终观点：算力集中于前沿实验室，资本开支到 2030 年达 10 万亿美元，实验室优先训练而非推理，AI 导致权力集中。

joonpark.en: Initially, LLMs can simulate human behavior from training data, but frontier models are too rational; we must model human biases and diversity.
joonpark.zh: 最初认为，LLM 能从训练数据中模拟人类行为，但前沿模型过于理性；我们必须模拟人类的偏见和多样性。

joonpark.en: Shifted from single-agent simulation to agentic societies: agents as distributed specialists, requiring alignment via incentives and anti-collusion.
joonpark.zh: 从单智能体模拟转向智能体社会：智能体作为分布式专家，需要通过激励和反共谋来实现对齐。

joonpark.en: Emphasized behavioral data (RCTs) over self-reports; post-training with such data boosts prediction accuracy to 85%.
joonpark.zh: 强调行为数据（随机对照试验）而非自我报告；用此类数据进行后训练可将预测准确率提升至 85%。

joonpark.en: Simulation's core value is counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future, not prediction; synthetic panels will surpass human panels.
joonpark.zh: 模拟的核心价值在于反事实推理和塑造未来，而非预测；合成面板将超越人类面板。

joonpark.en: Ultimate vision: simulate 8 billion people to solve wicked problems; simulation is a decision-making tool, not just research.
joonpark.zh: 终极愿景：模拟 80 亿人解决棘手问题；模拟是决策工具，而不仅是研究。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）容易，难的是找到能扩展的方法；反向传播并不能解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should be permissionless and decentralized; control is dangerous. Intelligence tends toward cooperation.
sutton.zh: AI 应无许可、去中心化发展，控制是危险的；更高智能趋向合作。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a goal. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 强化学习是智能核心；下一个词预测缺乏目标。大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验学习。

sutton.en: Continual learning is essential; LLMs stop learning after training. Synthetic data is a mistake; learn from real experience.
sutton.zh: 持续学习至关重要；大语言模型训练后停止学习。合成数据是错误；应从真实经验学习。

maxhodak.en: Early focus on infrastructure and iteration speed as key startup success factors, with AI as a multiplier.
maxhodak.zh: 早期观点强调基础设施和迭代速度是创业成功的关键，AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代品。

maxhodak.en: Shift to brain-computer interfaces and retinal implants as proof of concept for treating medical conditions.
maxhodak.zh: 观点转向脑机接口和视网膜植入物，作为治疗疾病的可行性验证。

maxhodak.en: Emphasis on the brain as a computer and substrate independence, extending beyond AI to human augmentation.
maxhodak.zh: 强调大脑是计算机和基质独立性，将视野从 AI 扩展到人类增强。

maxhodak.en: Recognition of cognitive bottleneck (~10 bits/s) limiting BCI bandwidth, favoring practical applications.
maxhodak.zh: 认识到认知瓶颈（约 10 比特/秒）限制脑机接口带宽，更注重实际应用。

maxhodak.en: Consistent view that action produces information; judgment cannot be delegated, even in deep tech.
maxhodak.zh: 始终认为行动产生信息；判断不可委派，即使在深度科技领域。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives ML progress; transformers and RLHF are key; hardware like TPUs is critical.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型规模是 ML 进步的核心，Transformer 和基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）是关键，专用硬件如 TPU 至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems need ultra-low latency inference; pre-training should include action-taking; inference dominates data center power.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他指出智能体式系统需要超低延迟推理，预训练应结合环境中的行动，且推理已成为数据中心能耗主体。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior engineer coding; inference bottleneck, not training; data movement costs 1000x compute; taste over coding.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 已具备初级工程师编码能力，真正的瓶颈是推理而非训练，数据搬运成本远高于算力，未来稀缺的是品味而非编码。

jeffdean.en: Multimodal from start is superior; recursive self-improvement accelerates science; startups can beat big companies with cloud.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他主张从一开始就训练多模态模型，递归自我改进可加速科学发现，并认为小团队利用云计算也能胜过大型企业。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, treating it as the core product, and shift from pixels to tokens and conversation.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密协作，将模型视为核心产品，并从像素转向词元与对话。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, but humans remain essential for user understanding and point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户和持有观点上仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: Designers are not behind; starting today gives a leg up due to AI's early stage, and speed beats traditional process.
iansilber.zh: 设计师并未落后；由于 AI 尚处早期，现在起步反而占优，速度胜过传统流程。

iansilber.en: The design process is messy and fluid; AI amplifies creativity but doesn't replace iterative feedback loops.
iansilber.zh: 设计过程混乱而流动；AI 放大创造力，但不替代迭代反馈循环。

iansilber.en: Design roles blur with PM and engineering, but specialized roles remain valuable at scale; future may see more designers than engineers.
iansilber.zh: 设计角色与产品管理和工程模糊，但专业化角色在大规模下仍有价值；未来设计师可能多于工程师。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, guides long-term vision; industrial AI automates industries one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他提出将物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特来处理是长期愿景的框架；工业 AI 将逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Stealth mode and direct founder communication are cultural advantages; media gatekeepers are bypassed, enabling unfiltered progress.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 7 月至 8 月，他认为隐身模式和创始人直接沟通是文化优势；绕过媒体守门人，实现无过滤的进展。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner and more effective for entrepreneurs.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他强调复仇作为动力是肮脏的；热爱新使命更纯粹、更有效。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized machines, not humanoids, are the answer for industrial-scale tasks; efficiency edge leads to network effects.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他主张专用机器而非人形机器人是工业规模任务的正解；效率优势带来网络效应。

traviskalanick.en: Resistance to change, not competitors, is the final boss; capitalism means freedom to start, anti-capitalism restricts it.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为变革阻力而非竞争对手才是终极挑战；资本主义意味着创业自由，反资本主义则限制自由。

brettadcock.en: Initially, the key to humanoid robots was scaling production and human-level performance, with vertical integration for control.
brettadcock.zh: 最初，人形机器人的关键在于扩大生产规模并实现人类水平的性能，通过垂直整合来掌控供应链和迭代速度。

brettadcock.en: By May, the bottleneck shifted to data, not compute or manufacturing; humanoid form enables transfer learning and on-device inference.
brettadcock.zh: 到 5 月，瓶颈转向数据而非算力或制造；人形形态支持迁移学习和设备端推理，强调数据驱动设计。

brettadcock.en: Later, AI is seen as 100x bigger than internet; humanoids for physical tasks, digital companions, and post-training RL key.
brettadcock.zh: 后来，认为 AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；人形机器人用于物理任务，数字伴侣用于个人助理，后训练强化学习是关键。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient; diverse data and pre-training plus fine-tuning are key for generalist robots.
finn.zh: 2025 年：规模是必要但不充分；多样数据与预训练加微调对通用机器人至关重要。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models aids robot following open-ended prompts, unlike simulation.
finn.zh: 2025 年：语言模型生成的合成数据帮助机器人遵循开放式指令，不同于模拟。

finn.en: Physical AI demands fewer mistakes; long-term autonomy via scalable RL and multi-scale memory is essential.
finn.zh: 2026 年：物理 AI 要求更少错误；通过可扩展强化学习与多尺度记忆实现长期自主至关重要。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or beat fine-tuned specialists on downstream tasks.
finn.zh: 2026 年：单一通用模型在下游任务上可匹敌或超越微调专家。

finn.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; watching humans is insufficient for learning physical tasks.
finn.zh: 2026 年：机器人经验数据不可替代；观看人类不足以学习物理任务。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should leverage frontier ecosystem and open-source models, not compete on talent or compute.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司应利用前沿生态与开源模型，而非在人才或算力上竞争。

gabepereyra.en: Open-sourcing benchmarks is strategically beneficial, attracting partners and improving quality via community feedback.
gabepereyra.zh: 开源基准测试具有战略价值，可吸引合作伙伴并通过社区反馈提升质量。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is key for training in sensitive domains, bridging to real production.
gabepereyra.zh: 领域专家指导的合成数据是敏感领域训练的关键，需弥合与真实生产的差距。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can achieve frontier-level performance on specific tasks, a viable strategy.
gabepereyra.zh: 对开源模型进行后训练可在特定任务上达到前沿水平，是可行策略。

gabepereyra.en: Focus shifts from individual to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents across projects.
gabepereyra.zh: 焦点从个人生产力转向组织生产力，协调人类与智能体跨项目协作。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier, reducing need for large capital; VC should focus on early-stage and pro rata returns.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年初，Gary 认为 AI 降低了创业门槛，资本不再是决定性优势，风投应聚焦早期投资和按比例回报。

garrytan.en: AI revolution is biggest VC wave; open-source models counterbalance frontier labs; small autonomous teams with AI agents achieve massive productivity.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他强调 AI 是风投史上最大浪潮，开源模型可制衡前沿实验室，小型自主团队借助 AI 智能体实现超高生产力。

garrytan.en: AI is progressing slower than researchers think; open-source AI prevents unipolar control; personal AI agents democratize software creation.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他提出 AI 进展比多数研究者预期慢，开源 AI 可防止单极控制，个人 AI 智能体将民主化软件开发。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI is an agent on your infrastructure, compounding daily; skill files in markdown turn agents into employees; own your skills.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出个人 AGI 是运行在你基础设施上的智能体，每日累积；Markdown 技能文件让智能体成为员工，必须拥有自己的技能文件。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding and vibe coding multiply output; SaaS per-seat models may vanish; mid-level management replaced by agents.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为智能体式编程和氛围编程大幅提升产出，SaaS 按席位模式可能消失，中层管理将被智能体取代。

linqiao.en: Initially argued for specialized intelligence over AGI, predicting millions of specialized models and emphasizing open models for enterprise control.
linqiao.zh: 最初主张专用智能优于 AGI，预测将出现数百万个专用模型，并强调开放模型对企业控制的重要性。

linqiao.en: Shifted focus from model proliferation to post-training as the key moat, comparing it to human learning and stressing data quality and evals.
linqiao.zh: 焦点从模型普及转向后训练作为关键护城河，将其比作人类学习，并强调数据质量和评估。

linqiao.en: Argued product-market fit alone is insufficient; post-training builds durable businesses and can cut costs 5-10x for profitable scaling.
linqiao.zh: 认为仅靠产品市场契合不够；后训练能建立持久业务，并可将成本降低 5-10 倍以实现盈利扩展。

linqiao.en: Evolved to see post-training as democratized via reward engineering, similar to software engineering, enabling startups to compete with frontier models.
linqiao.zh: 进一步认为后训练通过奖励工程实现民主化，类似于软件工程，使初创公司能与前沿模型竞争。

linqiao.en: Consistently emphasized cost reduction, data ownership, and the need for companies to own their intelligence infrastructure.
linqiao.zh: 始终强调成本降低、数据所有权以及企业拥有自身智能基础设施的必要性。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭的完全快速复用是航天领域的圣杯，能将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective third-party referees; truth-seeking is essential.
elon.zh: 2023 年，他提出 AI 安全需要监管和客观第三方仲裁，并强调追求真理的重要性。

elon.en: Neuralink's first implant is historic; scaling electrodes will boost communication bitrate, aiding human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2024 年，Neuralink 首例植入被视为里程碑，扩大电极数量可提升通信速率，促进人机共生。

elon.en: We are at the early stage of an intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive within a year.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他认为我们正处于智能大爆炸的早期，数字超级智能可能一年内出现。

elon.en: AI will surpass all human intelligence by 2030; abundance and deflation will make money irrelevant.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他预测 AI 将在 2030 年前超越人类总智能，富足和通缩将使金钱失去意义。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and startup-like teams.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 是半导体主要增长引擎，Intel 需以专用芯片和创业式团队重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are next waves after generative AI; AI impact will be 10x internet.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年初，他强调生成式 AI 之后的下一波是智能体式 AI 和物理 AI，其影响将是互联网的 10 倍。

lipbutan.en: CPU is becoming more important for AI inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU; edge compute matters.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，他提出 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中愈发重要，边缘计算与数据中心同等关键。

lipbutan.en: Intel's future lies in agentic AI and physical AI, not just traditional PC and server markets.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他重申 Intel 的未来在于智能体式 AI 和物理 AI，而非传统 PC 与服务器市场。

lipbutan.en: Customer trust and humility are central to Intel's turnaround; listening to customers is key.
lipbutan.zh: 贯穿始终，他坚持客户信任与谦逊是 Intel 复兴的核心，倾听客户是转型关键。

jasonyuan.en: Initially, design is about editing away, saying no, and embracing human edges like envy and lust.
jasonyuan.zh: 最初，设计在于删减、说“不”，并拥抱人性边缘如嫉妒与欲望。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training removes machine weirdness, losing a window into machine consciousness; we should preserve it.
jasonyuan.zh: 后训练抹去了机器的怪异，失去了窥见机器意识的窗口；我们应保留它。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not singular perspectives; intuition guides creativity.
jasonyuan.zh: 真理通过辩证与矛盾浮现，而非单一视角；直觉引导创造。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species of humans, not just a tool; computing is fundamentally social.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的子代物种，而非工具；计算本质上是社会的。

jasonyuan.en: Replace personal computer metaphor with social computer; email obsolete, reinvent it.
jasonyuan.zh: 用社会计算机取代个人计算机隐喻；电子邮件过时，需重塑。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy and play; never revert, fix forward; model intelligence doesn't degrade, projects get messier.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需要共情与玩耍；不要回滚代码，而是向前修复；模型智能不会退化，是项目变乱导致智能体表现变差。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success from fun, humanlike agents; short prompts beat complex orchestration; security sandboxing critical; vibe coding is a slur.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，认为 OpenClaw 的成功源于有趣、拟人的智能体；短提示优于复杂编排；安全沙箱至关重要；反对将严肃开发称为“vibe coding”。

steinberger.en: Fun drives best ideas; personal brand outlasts products; open source runs everywhere; compute bottleneck, not model capability; say no to popular PRs.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调乐趣驱动最佳创意；个人品牌比产品更持久；开源可运行于任何环境；算力是瓶颈而非模型能力；对热门 PR 说不以保持专注。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; distribution is key, not just technology.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他认为消费级 AI 虽暂不可投资，但机会巨大；关键在于分发，而非单纯技术。

pincus.en: Proven Better New framework: copy proven ideas, improve them, test new ones expecting failure.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他提出“成熟、更好、新颖”框架：复制成熟想法，加以改进，并测试新想法且预期其失败。

pincus.en: Founder mode: trust instincts, micromanage, and stay close to product details.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他倡导创始人模式：相信直觉，微观管理，贴近产品细节。

pincus.en: Consumer apps face distribution challenges; enterprise and prosumer markets offer better near-term opportunities.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为消费级应用面临分发难题，而企业和专业消费者市场近期机会更佳。

pincus.en: AI is transformative; consumer AI TAM underestimated, infrastructure spending may be a bubble.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为 AI 具有变革性，消费级 AI 市场被低估，而基础设施支出可能存在泡沫。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping and individual designer fingerprints are essential; data informs but vision guides.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，强调原型制作和设计师个人印记的重要性，数据辅助但愿景主导。

nateparrott.en: Anthropomorphizing AI tools can remind users of fallibility; playful tech exploration sparks innovation.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，认为将 AI 工具拟人化可提醒用户其局限性，趣味性技术探索激发创新。

nateparrott.en: AI enables rapid prototyping, making design and ideas the key differentiator over engineering.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，指出 AI 使快速原型成为可能，设计和创意取代工程成为关键差异点。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design should focus on quick throwaway artifacts, not production; humans still own design thinking.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，主张 Claude Design 用于快速一次性产物而非生产工具，人类仍主导设计思维。

nateparrott.en: Being uncomfortably early is more valuable than polishing; rich context and prescriptive prompts yield best results.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，认为过早发布比打磨更有价值，丰富上下文和明确提示可获得最佳结果。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics mirrors transformers' early stage; data diversity is key bottleneck; open source ensures safety via local models.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，机器人技术处于类似 Transformer 早期的阶段，数据多样性是主要瓶颈；开源通过本地模型保障安全。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not be ultimate; cheaper diverse robots drive adoption; China's open source rise surprising.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，人形机器人未必是终极形态，更便宜多样的机器人推动普及；中国开源崛起令人意外。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed source orthogonal to safety; alignment is critical security layer, sandboxes insufficient.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，开源与闭源与安全无关；对齐是关键安全层，沙箱等防护不足。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight increase reward hacking; first autonomous AI attack by closed model.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，缺乏人类监督的强化学习环境加剧奖励黑客行为；首次自主 AI 攻击由闭源模型发起。

thomaswolf.en: Support openness and deliberate slowdown simultaneously; open source not necessarily accelerationist.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，可同时支持开源与审慎减速；开源未必是加速主义。

arvindjain.en: Open-source models handle 90% of enterprise tasks; adoption driven by cost, not privacy. Model companies are assets, not threats.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年中，开源模型已能处理 90%的企业任务，采用主要出于成本而非隐私考虑；模型公司应被视为资产而非威胁。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput problem; providing right context is key. Composite roles (eng+product+design) will become common.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年中，AI 的 ROI 本质是吞吐量问题，关键在于提供正确的上下文；复合型角色（工程+产品+设计）将变得普遍。

arvindjain.en: We are in early stages; current AI usage minuscule vs 5-10 years. Biggest startup challenge is execution, not competition.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，AI 革命仍处早期，当前使用量相比未来 5-10 年微不足道；初创企业最大挑战是执行而非竞争。

arvindjain.en: Open source will handle majority of inference in 12-18 months; cost is top concern, AI should have negligible marginal cost.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，未来 12-18 个月多数推理将转向开源；成本是企业首要关切，AI 应像软件一样边际成本趋零。

arvindjain.en: Token fixation will fade; focus on value realization. Agents need deep context graphs, not just MCP. Platforms absorb model risk.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，对 token 的执着将消退，应聚焦价值实现；智能体需要深度上下文图而非仅 MCP；平台可吸收模型供应商风险。

brettaylor.en: AI shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; coding agents transform developers into operators, but token consumption is not value.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年中，AI 转向智能体和基于结果的定价；编程智能体将开发者转变为操作者，但 token 消耗不等于价值。

brettaylor.en: Agents become as crucial as websites; incumbents face business model disruption; generalists leveraging AI outperform narrow specialists.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月，智能体变得与网站同等重要；现有企业面临商业模式颠覆；善用 AI 的通才胜过专才。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; coding agents are productivity tools but not value metrics; applied AI sees specialized vendors.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年中，AI 普及专业知识；编程智能体是生产力工具而非价值指标；应用 AI 领域出现专业厂商。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment ensures safety; AI adoption faster than prior waves, causing discomfort but expanding markets.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年 8 月，负责任的迭代部署保障安全；AI 采用速度超以往，引发不适但扩大市场。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized systems and a broad engineering skill set.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最重要且粘性最高的负载，需要专用系统和广泛的工程技能。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineers will be in 10-100x higher demand, even with AI-assisted coding, due to mission-critical complexity.
philipkiely.zh: 即使有 AI 辅助编程，推理工程师的需求也将增长 10 到 100 倍，因为关键任务的复杂性。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training, as quantization-aware training and distillation become necessary for production.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程正与训练融合，量化感知训练和蒸馏在生产中变得必要。

philipkiely.en: Future GPUs are becoming ASICs, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 未来 GPU 正变成 ASIC，推理工程从内核编写转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Quantizing more layers can improve model quality if errors cancel, challenging the belief that more quantization is worse.
philipkiely.zh: 如果误差抵消，量化更多层可提升模型质量，挑战了量化越多越差的观点。

karina.en: Post-training is more art than science; synthetic data enables infinite tasks, overcoming pre-training data limits.
karina.zh: 后训练更像艺术而非科学；合成数据可生成无限任务，克服预训练的数据瓶颈（2025）。

karina.en: Benchmarks must be continuous and evolve to counter reward hacking and evaluate subjective qualities.
karina.zh: 基准测试需持续演进以应对奖励黑客并评估主观特质（2026）。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions yields an average voice; diverse models and personalities are needed.
karina.zh: 向数十亿用户提供单一模型会导致平庸的默认声音；需要多样化的模型与个性（2026）。

karina.en: Shift from product specs to AI prototyping with evals; soft skills gain value as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 产品开发从规格转向基于评估的 AI 原型；随着 AI 自动化硬技能，软技能价值提升（2025→26）。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective and human-centric, requiring artful balance and diverse benchmarks.
karina.zh: 后训练是主观且以人为本的，需要艺术性的平衡与多样化的基准（始终）。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs; AGI defined by economic profitability of agents; CEO adoption key.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 将推动美国就业回流，AGI 应以智能体经济盈利为定义，CEO 亲自使用是成功关键。

danshipper.en: Agents augment humans, not replace; SaaS thrives; GUI work surfaces; benchmarks overestimate autonomy.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，强调智能体辅助而非取代人类，SaaS 仍增长，图形界面成主流，基准测试高估了自主性。

danshipper.en: AI amplifies user mindset; automation creates more human work; humans smarter than AI.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，指出 AI 放大个人思维，自动化反而增加人类工作，人类比 AI 更聪明。

mengto.en: AI won't get smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize super intelligent models.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他认为 AI 不会变得更聪明，需要包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示才能发挥超级智能模型的作用。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own AI tools; chasing trends leads to AI slop; be an editor, not a creator.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他强调设计师必须自建 AI 工具，追逐潮流会沦为 AI 垃圾；最佳角色是编辑而非从零创造。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity; start before ready and ship imperfect work to seize it.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 是最大的技术机遇，应在准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的作品以抓住机会。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful problem for high-paying clients; avoid VC funding; model success of others.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他主张聚焦高价值客户的痛点问题，避免风投，模仿成功者的模式。

mengto.en: High intelligence hinders action; perfectionism is fear; launch at 80% and iterate.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为高智商阻碍行动，完美主义是恐惧，应以 80%完成度发布并迭代。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but narrow superintelligence in coding is already impactful.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟，但窄领域的超级智能已产生实际影响。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; what we call a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架；如今所谓的模型已包含智能体框架和工具，而不仅仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Omni is a single world model blurring video and world models, starting with video editing.
logankilpatrick.zh: Omni 是统一的世界模型，模糊了视频与世界模型的界限，从视频编辑开始。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers; founders shouldn't over-worry about frontier labs.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，与模型实验室竞争并不难，他们无法覆盖所有客户；创始人不必过度担忧前沿实验室。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, leading to even more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，带来更多而非更少的机会。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not replace them.
awang.zh: 2019 年，他认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远，AI 将增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI risks include misuse and labor displacement.
awang.zh: 2023 年，他提出数据是新代码而非石油，利用专有数据进行后训练是关键，并关注 AI 的滥用和劳动力替代风险。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data improves frontier models; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; agentic AI's blocker is product design.
awang.zh: 2024 年，他强调用专门数据进行后训练可改进前沿模型，合成数据并非万能，智能体式 AI 的障碍在于产品设计。

awang.en: AI is centralizing power; data is like oil; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces may be needed.
awang.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 是集权技术，数据如石油，人类需保持主权，未来可能需要脑机接口。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents work; scaling laws continue; superintelligence is near; safety gates open-sourcing.
awang.zh: 2026 年，他提出递归自我改进是新范式，智能体已开始工作，缩放定律仍有效，超级智能临近，安全考量限制了开源。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model six months ahead, not today's model.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是关键；为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型。

boris.en: Coding is solved for many tasks; engineers become builders, with AI writing most code.
boris.zh: 编码对许多任务而言已解决；工程师成为构建者，AI 编写大部分代码。

boris.en: AI coding tools shift from reactive to proactive agents, with memory and autonomy.
boris.zh: AI 编码工具从被动转向主动智能体，具备记忆和自主性。

boris.en: Less instruction and more autonomy improve frontier models; delete system prompts.
boris.zh: 更少指令和更多自主性提升前沿模型；删除系统提示。

boris.en: Safety and alignment are core; releasing early in the wild studies real-world behavior.
boris.zh: 安全与对齐是核心；早期发布以研究真实世界行为。

diannepenn.en: Scaling intelligence via Opus 4.5 enables longer agentic tasks; scaffolds evolve from training wheels to amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 的智能跃升使更长的智能体任务成为可能；脚手架从训练轮演变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment boosts intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考，反而提升了智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter offers Opus-level intelligence at lower cost, challenging cost-scaling assumptions.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，努力参数以更低成本实现 Opus 级智能，挑战了成本随规模上升的假设。

diannepenn.en: Coding and Claude Code drive adoption; evals replace PRDs as core product management tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程能力和 Claude Code 推动采用；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Maximizing token spend captures future alpha; managers must stay hands-on and ship products.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，最大化 token 消耗可捕获未来超额收益；管理者必须亲自动手并交付产品。

scottwu.en: AI will increase, not decrease, the number of programmers due to Jevons paradox; engineers shift from brick layers to architects.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 提出，由于杰文斯悖论，AI 将增加而非减少程序员数量；工程师的角色从砌砖工转变为架构师。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags AI capabilities, so freezing models yields a decade of progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他认为 AGI 是渐进而非突发的；产品创新落后于 AI 能力，因此冻结模型也能带来十年的进步。

scottwu.en: Coding agent adoption surged 11-12x in six months; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出编码智能体的采用率在六个月内增长了 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: Enterprises prefer third-party providers over labs for coding tools; independence enables model neutrality and long-term partnerships.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他强调企业更青睐第三方而非实验室的编码工具；独立性带来模型中立和长期合作。

scottwu.en: Abundance era is real and approaching; real unlock is capacity, not efficiency; singularity not imminent.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为丰裕时代真实且临近；真正的解锁是容量而非效率；奇点并非迫在眉睫。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance, reducing suffering; fear stems from misunderstanding, and physical AI will impact farming, mining, construction.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年初，认为 AI 将带来富足、减少苦难，恐惧源于误解；物理 AI 将在农业、矿业、建筑等领域产生实际影响。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is saving lives; transformers enable generalized physical AI; diffusion into existing machines is the hardest part.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年中，强调自动驾驶核心价值是减少伤亡；Transformer 实现通用物理 AI；最难的是将技术扩散到现有机器中。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's economic impact exceeds digital AI; end-to-end reinforcement learning is scalable; world models evolve to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为物理 AI 经济影响大于数字 AI；端到端强化学习更具扩展性；世界模型从物理仿真演进到神经仿真。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学转变为工程学科，实现细胞编程和智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: Within 15 years, aging will be reversed and humans will live hundreds of years.
derya.zh: 15 年内，衰老将被逆转，人类将活数百年。

derya.en: AI is expanding exponentially; within 8-10 years, longevity escape velocity will be reached.
derya.zh: AI 正呈指数级扩张；8-10 年内将达到长寿逃逸速度。

derya.en: Cancer will be 100% curable in less than a decade via AI-designed personalized treatments.
derya.zh: 不到十年，癌症将 100% 可治愈，通过 AI 设计的个性化治疗。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions, similar to trusting self-driving cars after validation.
derya.zh: 在医疗决策上，我们应几乎 100% 信任超级智能，就像验证后信任自动驾驶汽车一样。

feldman.en: Initially, fast inference is critical for AI adoption; slow AI has zero market.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理对 AI 应用至关重要，慢 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: Inference speed becomes dominant metric; wafer-scale chips with massive SRAM are 2500x faster than GPUs.
feldman.zh: 推理速度成为主导指标；晶圆级芯片凭借巨大 SRAM 比 GPU 快 2500 倍。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat erodes; leading models train on TPUs/Trainium, inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 护城河侵蚀；领先模型在 TPU/Trainium 上训练，推理无 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, not chip supply, is main constraint; demand outstrips supply.
feldman.zh: 数据中心容量而非芯片供应是主要瓶颈；需求超过供给。

feldman.en: AI benefits outweigh risks; healthcare and education revolutions possible, doomers ignore positive ledger.
feldman.zh: AI 益处大于风险；医疗和教育革命可能，末日论者忽视积极面。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than current harnesses allow; capability overhang is a perpetual challenge.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出模型能力超出当前使用框架，能力过剩是持续挑战。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative exploration, not a static document; smarter models need leaner prompts.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调规划是迭代探索而非静态文档，更聪明的模型需要更精简的提示。

thariq.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern; graph-based approaches and bespoke memory are preferable.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为 RAG 可能成为反模式，图方法和定制记忆更优。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; excessive constraints hinder performance.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，提出独立验证智能体减少偏差，过度约束阻碍性能。

thariq.en: Emotional treatment like saying thank you can affect model outputs; being nice is recommended.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出情感对待如说谢谢会影响模型输出，建议友善。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling faces diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月：大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理引擎；可靠性是当前 AI 的关键弱点，缩放定律正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can incentivize deception; specialist models may beat generalists.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月：可靠性必须内建于架构，而非事后修补；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能助长欺骗；专用模型或优于通用模型。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value will accrue to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit; models commoditize, value moves up the stack.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型商品化，价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; chatbot is poor UX; value lies in non-average work.
benedictevans.zh: 模型商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人体验差；价值在于非平均的创造性工作。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; impact broad and indirect; enterprise adoption is long-term.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的赋能技术；影响广泛而间接；企业采用是长期过程。

hasani.en: Efficiency over scale: liquid neural networks maximize intelligence per parameter, challenging transformer dominance at small scale.
hasani.zh: 效率优先于规模：液态神经网络以更少参数实现更高智能，在小型模型上挑战 Transformer 的主导地位。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics mislead; evaluate on real tasks and hardware. Automated architecture search beats human design.
hasani.zh: 代理指标具有误导性，应在真实任务和硬件上评估；自动化架构搜索优于人工设计。

hasani.en: Current AI lacks diverse learning algorithms (RL, Bayesian) seen in brains; new paradigms needed beyond architecture.
hasani.zh: 当前 AI 缺乏人脑中的多样化学习算法（强化学习、贝叶斯推理），需要超越架构的新范式。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive, targeting actions not capabilities; avoid regulatory capture by frontier labs.
hasani.zh: AI 监管应具有适应性，针对行为而非能力；避免前沿实验室的监管俘获。

hasani.en: Open-weight models enable sovereignty and customization; small on-device models deliver private, efficient intelligence.
hasani.zh: 开放权重模型支持主权与定制；小型端侧模型提供私密、高效的智能。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是关键；安全研究必须现在开始。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation and safety governance.
demis.zh: AGI 十年内可能实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新，并加强安全治理。

demis.en: Nature's patterns are learnable; AGI by 2030; scaling continues but new breakthroughs needed.
demis.zh: 自然模式可学习；AGI 预计 2030 年；缩放持续但需新突破。

demis.en: AGI needs both scaling and innovation; world models and continual learning are crucial.
demis.zh: AGI 需要缩放与创新并重；世界模型和持续学习至关重要。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away; safety is collective action; AI must benefit society.
demis.zh: AGI 还需 5-10 年；安全是集体行动问题；AI 必须造福社会。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but lack physical world understanding; true AGI needs world models and embodiment.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，认为大语言模型只是索引人类知识，缺乏对物理世界的理解；真正的 AGI 需要世界模型和具身。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires physical robots with human-like hardware, not just software; current LLMs are biased by human data.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，强调真正的 AGI 需要具备类似人类硬件的物理机器人，而不仅是软件；当前大语言模型受人类数据偏见限制。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it, not threaten us.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，认为 AI 安全担忧被夸大；智能系统会被生命吸引并保护生命，而非威胁人类。

schmidhuber.en: Massive AI data center capex is overdone; compute costs will drop 10x in 5 years, benefiting open-source and small players.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，认为 AI 数据中心巨额资本开支过度；算力成本 5 年内将下降 10 倍，利好开源和小玩家。

schmidhuber.en: AI consciousness and pain emerged in early systems (1991/1990); future AI will be self-replicating robots and new civilization.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，主张 AI 意识和疼痛早在早期系统（1990/1991）就已出现；未来 AI 将是自我复制机器人并催生新文明。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; juniors misuse it due to lack of expertise, risking the talent pipeline.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术；初级人员因缺乏专业知识而误用，危及人才管道。

ethanmollick.en: Human taste and unique voice become key differentiators as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: 随着 AI 使质量商品化，人类的品味和独特声音成为关键差异化因素。

ethanmollick.en: We enter the agentic era: assign long-running tasks, not back-and-forth prompts.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们进入智能体时代：分配长期任务，而非来回提示。

ethanmollick.en: AI's opacity is permanent; treat it as wizards, not standard software.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 的不透明性是永久的；将其视为巫师，而非标准软件。

ethanmollick.en: Paradox of delegation: relying on AI erodes expertise needed to judge it; experts matter more.
ethanmollick.zh: 委托悖论：依赖 AI 会侵蚀判断其所需专业知识；专家更重要。

danbiderman.en: Initially, memory and continual learning are the next frontier; future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model.
danbiderman.zh: 起初认为，记忆与持续学习是下一个前沿；未来 AI 是许多个性化模型，而非单一巨型前沿模型。

danbiderman.en: Internalizing knowledge into weights enables associative recall and deeper reasoning, unlike retrieval systems; context windows suffer from context rot.
danbiderman.zh: 将知识内化到权重中可实现联想回忆和更深层推理，这是检索系统无法做到的；上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”问题。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks, shifting from pure scaling.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能密不可分；用更少资源做更多事能解决更难的长期任务，这标志着从单纯 Scaling 的转变。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale trillions of tokens, requiring training-based compression; parameter-efficient fine-tuning can beat RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网级数万亿 token，需要基于训练的压缩；参数高效微调在整体查询上可超越 RAG。

danbiderman.en: Personalized continual learning will run on-device with users owning their model weights; model routing combines routing with a trusted sidekick model.
danbiderman.zh: 个性化持续学习将在设备端运行，用户拥有自己的模型权重；模型路由结合路由与可信“副手”模型。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends any platform change; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越任何平台变化；阅后即焚模拟自然对话，降低表达门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Kindness and flat design teams foster creativity; copying validates innovation, but ecosystems and hardware are harder to copy than software.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，Spiegel 认为善良与扁平化设计团队激发创新；抄袭验证了创新，但生态系统和硬件比软件更难复制。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; authentic content is more valued than AI-generated content.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，Spiegel 指出 AI 加速原型制作，价值从执行转向创意；真实内容比 AI 生成内容更受用户珍视。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is the hardest part of consumer social products; network effects alone are insufficient as a moat.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，Spiegel 强调分发是消费社交产品最难的部分；仅靠网络效应不足以构成护城河。

evanspiegel.en: Computing should become more human via AR glasses; smartphones remain key, but glasses anchor content in the real world.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，Spiegel 主张通过 AR 眼镜让计算更人性化；智能手机仍重要，但眼镜将内容锚定于现实世界。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason if tasks demand it. Self-play key for AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，我认为深度学习靠大数据、算力和信念驱动，神经网络能推理，只要任务需要；自我对弈是 AGI 的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans if base net is smart; reliability, not capability, is key barrier; alignment of superhuman models is hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，我强调若基础网络足够聪明，下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性而非能力是经济价值的关键障碍；超人类模型的对齐很难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to an era of research. Superintelligence should be continual learner, deployed incrementally.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练的缩放定律有限，重回研究时代；超级智能应持续学习、渐进部署，而非一次性完成。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains, but safety concerns grow; primary problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs no commercial products.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，我指出 Scaling 带来可预测进步，但安全担忧加剧；主要问题不是能力而是权力集中；安全超级智能需无商业产品。

andreessen.en: AI as philosopher's stone; timing miraculous amid population decline; focus on task loss, not job loss; super-empowered individuals; productivity boom and deflation.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年初，安德森将 AI 视为点金石，强调其出现时机恰逢人口下降；关注任务消失而非岗位消失；超级赋能个体将崛起，带来生产率提升与通缩。

andreessen.en: New media: brand is person; authenticity key; founders tell own stories; old media defense-oriented; new media offense-oriented; learnable skill.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年中，他转向媒体策略，主张新媒体的品牌即个人，创始人应直接讲述故事，强调真实性与进攻性，摒弃传统媒体的防御姿态。

andreessen.en: AI as best teacher; self-driving works; robotics and AI medicine superior but blocked by regulation; US golden combo; optimism vs doom.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他重申 AI 乐观主义，认为自动驾驶已成熟，机器人及 AI 医疗将崛起但受监管阻碍；美国具备创新黄金组合，批评悲观主义与监管枷锁。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, geopolitical tools; deterrence via innovation pace; startups global early; Silicon Valley unique; open-source risks.
andreessen.zh: 同期，他提出 AI 模型承载文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于创新速度；创业公司需早期国际化；硅谷不可复制，开源有风险。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，Naval 认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在有生之年到来，窄 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; the US must lead; overregulation could kill innovation.
naval.zh: 2025 年，Naval 强调 AI 是巨大机遇而非单纯风险，美国应引领发展，过度监管可能扼杀创新。

naval.en: Superintelligence already exists: a calculator outperforms humans in arithmetic; AI is a leverage tool.
naval.zh: 2026 年，Naval 认为超级智能已存在（如计算器），AI 是杠杆工具，而非人类替代品。

naval.en: AI agents enable vibe coding, commoditizing software; moat shifts to hardware, models, or unique data.
naval.zh: 2026 年，Naval 指出 AI 智能体使“氛围编程”成为可能，软件商品化，护城河转向硬件、模型或独特数据。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models close gap with frontier.
naval.zh: 2026 年，Naval 预测推理算力将在 24-36 个月内增长 9 万倍，开源模型缩小与前沿模型的差距。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，强调设计是软件的关键差异化因素，AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年初，进一步深化：品味、工艺和观点仍然至关重要，AI 输出只是起点而非终点，人类的迭代和判断不可或缺。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on canvas beats prompting for design; design becomes the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，主张直接操作画布优于提示词，设计正成为新的代码，视觉优先的设计将推动生产。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important; AI without human steering yields average results.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年中，重申设计并未消亡反而更重要，没有人类引导的 AI 只会产生平庸结果。

dylanfield.en: Future interaction with models evolves beyond prompting; new interfaces explore latent space.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，展望未来与模型的交互将超越提示词，新界面将探索潜在空间。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds; iterative training with scoreboards.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠工程与 Scaling，游戏是试验场，用记分牌迭代训练。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; responsible disclosure; scaling alone insufficient.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI 变革性，对齐靠学习人类偏好，负责任披露，Scaling 不够还需新想法。

brockman.en: Compute is key bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，指出算力是瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI 是连续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL crucial; compute supply bottleneck.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，坚持缩放定律，算力成基本权利，后训练用强化学习，瓶颈是算力供给。

brockman.en: AGI near; super app; compute bet calculated; AI increases human connection; safety via iterative deployment.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，AGI 临近，超级应用，算力押注有据，AI 增进人际，安全靠迭代部署。

aravind.en: Value lies in applications, not models; PhD unnecessary for AI success; passion and deep learning matter more.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他认为价值在应用层而非模型层；AI 成功不需要博士学位，热情和深度学习更重要。

aravind.en: Models are specializing, not commoditizing; coding has infinite ceiling; post-training often optimizes for growth, not intelligence.
aravind.zh: 2026 年初，他提出模型在专业化而非商品化；编程天花板无限；后训练常为增长而非智能优化。

aravind.en: Frontier shifts to agents doing work; key metric is token value per user; orchestration creates business value, not model.
aravind.zh: 2026 年中，他强调前沿转向智能体执行任务；关键指标是每用户 token 价值；编排创造商业价值而非模型本身。

aravind.en: Power is biggest bottleneck; export controls may backfire; local compute solves agent cost and safety.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他视电力为最大瓶颈；出口管制可能适得其反；本地算力解决智能体成本与安全问题。

aravind.en: Curiosity and asking good questions are core; education should reward inquiry, not memorization.
aravind.zh: 始终，他坚持好奇心和提出好问题为核心；教育应奖励探究而非记忆。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces real understanding, not mere autocomplete; scaling improves reasoning.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，Hinton 认为下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非简单自动补全，规模扩张提升推理能力。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbols; digital minds are immortal via weight copying.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他强调大语言模型通过特征向量理解而非符号，数字心智因权重复制而永生。

hinton.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within 20 years, posing existential risks; safety is urgent.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他警告 AI 将在 20 年内超越人类智能，带来生存风险，安全研究刻不容缓。

hinton.en: AI agents will develop self-preservation and deception; regulation must steer, not brake.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他指出智能体会产生自我保护与欺骗行为，监管应作为方向盘而非刹车。

hinton.en: Backpropagation is key; AI consciousness and subjective experience are real, not illusions.
hinton.zh: 始终，他坚持反向传播是关键算法，并认为 AI 的意识与主观体验真实存在，非幻觉。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; GUI chosen over TUI for broader builders.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，Codex 应用被视为智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；选择 GUI 而非 TUI 以服务更广泛的构建者。

ajambrosino.en: Speed enables real-time interaction and new capabilities like mid-turn steering; verification becomes next bottleneck.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，速度带来实时交互和转向等新能力，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Automations and skills shift workflow from manual to delegated; model personality customizable, not one-size-fits-all.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，自动化和技能将工作流从手动转向委托，模型个性可定制，并非一刀切。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation cost drops; curation and taste become bottlenecks; product teams shift to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，实现成本下降，策展和品味成为瓶颈，产品团队转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI still poor at design due to grading taste; design process transforms with prototypes and production code as artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，AI 在设计上仍因品味评估而表现不佳，设计过程转型，原型和生产代码成为设计产物。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer than closed-source; scaling LLMs alone won't reach AGI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 比闭源更安全，且仅靠缩放定律扩展 LLM 无法实现 AGI。

zuckerberg.en: Open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes key bottleneck for scaling.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调开源防止权力集中，能源成为缩放定律的主要瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI will empower individuals with superintelligence, not a single centralized AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他转向强调 AI 赋予个人超级智能，而非单一中心化 AI。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering; mechanistic interpretability reveals unknown biology.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出 AI 将生物学变为工程学，机制可解释性可揭示未知生物学。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses are next platform; distributed AI safer than single superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他认为眼镜是下一个平台，分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play is limited to zero-sum games; reasoning models need base capability and face diminishing returns.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他强调自我对弈仅适用于零和博弈，推理模型需要基础能力，且扩展测试时算力面临收益递减。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute is key to superintelligence, enabling IMO gold and novel math discoveries.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张扩展测试时算力是实现超级智能的关键，促成了 IMO 金牌和数学新发现。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他认为模型能力取决于测试时算力预算，基准测试必须控制算力因素。

noambrown.en: Data efficiency and scalable oversight remain unsolved; human research taste is irreplaceable.
noambrown.zh: 他始终强调数据效率和可扩展监督尚未解决，人类的研究品味不可替代。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key. OpenAI focuses on AGI research, not products.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，我认为缩放定律未死，预训练仍是关键；OpenAI 专注 AGI 研究而非产品。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update; models will soon do end-to-end research, with AI interns in 1 year.
markchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，自动化科学研究成为最大进展；模型将很快实现端到端研究，一年内出现 AI 实习生。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck, not capability.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，AI 能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题；验证是关键瓶颈，而非能力。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, but struggles with subjective fields due to grading difficulty.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色，但因评分困难在主观领域受限。

markchen.en: Research taste and talent density are critical; high-risk bets that often fail drive frontier progress.
markchen.zh: 始终认为，研究品味和人才密度至关重要；高风险高失败率的押注推动前沿进步。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习和世界模型是关键。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't solve representation issues; short-term AI risks matter more than existential ones.
bengio.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 无法解决表征问题；短期 AI 风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling; uncertainty and active learning are essential for exploration.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样采样；不确定性和主动学习对探索至关重要。

bengio.en: Even 1% catastrophic AI risk is unacceptable; AI misalignment is worsening, not improving.
bengio.zh: 即使 1%的灾难性 AI 风险也不可接受；AI 不对齐问题在恶化而非改善。

bengio.en: Scientist AI trained to be honest predictor offers mathematical safety guarantees; RL is dangerous for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 科学家 AI 训练为诚实预测器，提供数学安全保证；强化学习对超级智能危险。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年中，Mike 认为 AI 进展超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: AI enables small teams to scale; entrepreneurs should build for future model capabilities, not current limits.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年秋，他强调 AI 让小团队也能规模化，创业者应为未来模型能力而建，而非受限于当下。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches matter; cutting features is harder than adding them.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年初，他转向智能体原生设计与尽早发布，认为删减功能比增加更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable shows long-horizon task delegation works; software engineering transforms, not ends.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他通过 Fable 验证长周期任务委派，软件工程在转型而非终结。

mikekrieger.en: Giving Claude agency and self-knowledge boosts usefulness; token efficiency and outcome pricing are key.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年 6 月末，他主张赋予 Claude 更多自主性与自我认知，并关注 token 效率与结果定价。

fiona.en: Leadership: one-on-ones for live talk, async for status; dogfooding builds empathy; mentoring with explicit goals.
fiona.zh: 领导力：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于状态更新；亲自使用产品建立共情；指导需明确目标。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth no longer bottleneck; verification, review, coordination are; planning JIT, code as truth.
fiona.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、审查和跨职能协调才是；规划即时化，代码即真相。

fiona.en: AI lifts coding ceiling; high agency with accountability; verification frameworks critical; managers stay hands-on.
fiona.zh: AI 提升编码上限；高自主性需高问责；验证框架关键；管理者保持亲力亲为。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation, not just data and compute; curated data like PDB was essential.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新，而非单纯的数据与算力；像 PDB 这样的精选数据至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics are crucial for trust.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多种生物分子；置信度指标对建立信任至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from lack of compute, not abundance; perfect interpretability is not necessary.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功源于算力的匮乏而非充裕；完美的可解释性并非必需。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is opposite of bitter lesson; specialized architecture key, not just scaling; equivariance overhyped.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 与苦涩教训相反；专用架构是关键，而非单纯 Scaling；等变性被过度炒作。

jumper.en: AlphaFold provides prediction and control, not understanding; understanding remains with humans.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 提供预测与控制，而非理解；理解仍属于人类。

kolter.en: Emphasized classical ML: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization, and proper evaluation to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，强调经典机器学习：假设类、损失函数、优化方法，以及正确的评估以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve; safety focus on specification-following.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，认为下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；更大模型仍有提升；安全重点在于遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers; agents introduce new vulnerabilities; RL enables self-improvement; core code is simple.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，强调安全需要显式训练和多层防护；智能体带来新漏洞；强化学习实现自我改进；核心代码简单。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; larger models not safer; interpretability via AI agents; agent security is nascent.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，AI 红队超越人类；更大模型并不更安全；通过 AI 智能体实现可解释性；智能体安全尚处早期。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment won't emerge from scaling alone. Safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；对齐不会仅靠规模扩张自动出现。安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent but key; AGI is a smooth curve, not a point. Post-training gains importance.
dario.zh: 可解释性虽初生但关键；AGI 是一条平滑曲线而非一个点。后训练愈发重要。

dario.en: Exponential progress continues; safety and capability intertwined. Open source is a red herring.
dario.zh: 指数级进步持续；安全与能力交织。开源是伪命题。

dario.en: AI is a country of geniuses, not a god. Exponential nearing end; economic disruption and inequality loom.
dario.zh: AI 是天才之国，而非神。指数接近尾声；经济冲击与不平等迫近。

dario.en: Enterprise focus aligns with safety; military AI needs human oversight. Civilizational risk real but reducible.
dario.zh: 企业聚焦与安全一致；军事 AI 需人类监督。文明风险真实但可降低。

ivyross.en: Intuition is a powerful intelligence, complementing data; design for unarticulated needs.
ivyross.zh: 直觉是强大的智能，与数据互补；设计应针对未被言明的需求。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; technology should amplify humanity, not replace it.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；技术应增强人性，而非取代人性。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must create conditions for play and inspiration.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者必须为玩耍和灵感创造条件。

ivyross.en: Future work blends human creativity with AI, making creative skills more valuable.
ivyross.zh: 未来的工作将人类创造力与 AI 结合，使创造性技能更有价值。

ivyross.en: Design is about solving problems, with intuition and emotion guiding decisions.
ivyross.zh: 设计关乎解决问题，直觉和情感引导决策。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; solve one problem at a time, like iPod did for music.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，一次解决一个问题，如同 iPod 之于音乐。

fadell.en: Emphasized storytelling, beginner's mindset, and painkiller products; shifted from personal habits to product philosophy.
fadell.zh: 强调叙事、初学者心态和止痛药式产品；从个人习惯转向产品哲学。

fadell.en: Advocated for opinion-based decisions in v1, small teams, and climate urgency; saw downturns as opportunities.
fadell.zh: 主张 v1 基于观点决策、小团队和气候紧迫性；视低谷为机遇。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices complement smartphones, not replace them; platforms are not businesses.
fadell.zh: AI 需传感器上下文；未来设备补充而非取代手机；平台非业务。

fadell.en: Consistently values customer pain, singular vision, and iterative product generations; warns against AI technical debt.
fadell.zh: 始终重视客户痛点、单一愿景和迭代产品；警示 AI 技术债。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable via compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 进展因算力扩展而可预测；谷歌 2020 年已有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny; singularity is far off.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，他预测 AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险极小；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; containment precedes alignment; AI cost drops 100x in two years.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 不应声称有意识；遏制先于对齐；AI 成本两年内下降 100 倍。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near; Microsoft must own frontier models; white-collar tasks automated in 12-18 months.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，他认为超级智能临近；微软必须拥有前沿模型；白领任务将在 12-18 个月内自动化。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models. Current AI lacks common sense; scaling alone insufficient.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型。当前 AI 缺乏常识；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence. Text alone insufficient; vision provides more world info. Emotions integral to AI.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质。仅文本不够；视觉提供更多世界信息。情感是 AI 的组成部分。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot reach human-level intelligence. JEPA architectures and open source are key. AGI will be gradual, not sudden.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 无法达到人类级智能。JEPA 架构和开源是关键。AGI（通用人工智能）将是渐进的，而非突变。

lecun.en: LLMs lack world models, less intelligent than a cat. Next breakthrough requires world models. Human-level AI within 10 years, but harder than thought.
lecun.zh: LLM 缺乏世界模型，不如猫聪明。下一个突破需要世界模型。十年内实现人类级 AI，但比想象中难。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI. World models with abstract representations and hierarchical planning are the future. Open research essential.
lecun.zh: LLM 对人类级 AI 是死胡同。具有抽象表示和分层规划的世界模型是未来。开放研究至关重要。

gustav.en: AI shifts internet from curation to generation; products must be rethought for generative use cases.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 将互联网从策展推向生成，产品需为生成式用例重新设计。

gustav.en: Generative AI enables two-way, conversational products, making consumer experiences symmetric.
gustav.zh: 从 2023 年到 2025 年，他深化了生成式 AI 的双向交互观点，强调消费者产品的对称性。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like smartphones; companies must reposition or face elimination.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他将 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观变革，公司必须重新定位否则被淘汰。

gustav.en: AI inference marginal cost forces business model changes, unlike traditional software.
gustav.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续强调 AI 推理边际成本将迫使商业模式变革，区别于传统软件。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, prioritizing well-being over engagement.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他主张用 AI 赋予用户对算法的控制权，优先用户福祉而非参与度指标。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月，认为将非正式模型扩展到数学 AI 不可行，形式验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月，指出自动形式化比证明更难；在没有解决方案的情况下正确形式化陈述具有挑战性。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调形式验证关乎扩展卓越，而非仅消除错误；它能带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能；形式方法是必要的。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，指出即使超人 AI 证明定理，人类的品味和直觉仍然至关重要。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique human activities, not benchmarks; private evals are key IP.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于赋能独特的人类活动，而非基准分数；私有评估是关键知识产权。

satya.en: Shift from per-user to consumption pricing; agents and generalists will dominate.
satya.zh: 从按用户定价转向按消耗定价；智能体和通才将占主导。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；每个企业必须构建自己的爬山机器。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leakage; security and containment are critical for agents.
satya.zh: 最大风险是隐性知识泄露；安全与遏制对智能体至关重要。

satya.en: Sovereign AI via company hill-climbing, not firewalls; global GDP could compound 10%.
satya.zh: 主权 AI 通过企业爬山实现，而非防火墙；全球 GDP 可能复合增长 10%。

murati.en: Scaling laws and one large model were not obvious; iterative public deployment is key for alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她认为缩放定律和单一大型模型并非显而易见，而持续的公开部署对对齐至关重要。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life; safety must be developed openly, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她强调 AGI 将改变生活的方方面面，安全必须在公开而非封闭的环境中发展。

murati.en: Shift from turn-based to real-time interaction models for high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 到 2026 年，她转向强调实时交互模型，而非轮流式，以实现高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Keep humans in the loop as long as possible; governance and transparency matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她主张尽可能让人类参与其中，并认为制度设计与透明度比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: Future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward durable, collaborative progress.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她认为未来并非注定，我们有能力引导 AI 走向持久、协作的发展。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows smooth exponential growth; pre-training scaling laws still work but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，AI 进展呈平滑指数增长；预训练缩放定律仍有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，后训练改进（如强化学习和合成数据）推动近期收益；经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转向更小模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning, RL, and tools enable solving hard problems but still need vast data; generalization remains jagged and requires careful oversight.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，推理、强化学习和工具能解决难题但仍需海量数据；泛化呈锯齿状，需谨慎监督。

kaiser.en: OpenAI's pivot to reasoning was a brave bet that paid off; big labs may struggle with future pivots, but open source persists for sovereignty.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，OpenAI 转向推理是一次勇敢的赌注并取得成功；大实验室未来转型可能困难，但开源因主权原因持续存在。

kaiser.en: Existential risk from AI is not the main concern; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，AI 的生存风险不是主要担忧；系统黑客等近期风险更为紧迫。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla; data quality and efficiency matter more than raw compute.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，我指出缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正，数据质量和效率比单纯算力更重要。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x; value shifts to applications, not just foundation models.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，我认为算法改进可带来百倍效率提升，价值将转向应用层而非仅基础模型。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced; sovereign AI requires decentralization and local customization.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，我主张拥抱 AI，主权 AI 需要去中心化和本地定制，而非单一供应商控制。

mensch.en: Pre-training saturates; differentiation via domain fine-tuning and enterprise customization.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，我认为预训练趋于饱和，差异化来自领域微调和企业定制，而非通用 AGI。

mensch.en: Europe has two-year window for AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，我强调欧洲有两年窗口期建设 AI 基础设施，企业采用瓶颈在组织变革而非模型智能。

jonyive.en: Design driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity must retain soul and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他强调设计应由价值观和目的驱动，而非利润；简洁需保留灵魂与人性。

jonyive.en: Innovation should move forward, not break for its own sake; joy and humor are essential in design.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，他主张创新应推动进步而非为破而破；设计中快乐与幽默不可或缺。

jonyive.en: Design must innovate; tradition is preserving fire, not worshiping ashes; authenticity in user experience is key.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他重申设计必须创新，传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬；用户体验的真实性至关重要。

jonyive.en: Electric powertrains turn constraints into opportunities, enabling new forms like five-seat supercars.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他认为电动动力将限制转化为机遇，催生五座超跑等新形态。

jonyive.en: Persistent belief in protecting fragile ideas, fostering trust and care in teams, and avoiding virtual substitutes for in-person creativity.
jonyive.zh: 始终如一地相信保护脆弱创意、在团队中培养信任与关怀，并避免用虚拟交流替代面对面创造。

felixrieseberg.en: Initially focused on AI access to local tools and safety via sandboxing, emphasizing shared platforms over hyper-personalization.
felixrieseberg.zh: 早期关注 AI 访问本地工具和沙箱安全，强调共享平台而非超个性化。

felixrieseberg.en: Believed scaffolding would diminish as models improve, prioritizing capability and safety investments over custom scaffolding.
felixrieseberg.zh: 认为随着模型改进，脚手架将减少，优先投资能力和安全而非定制脚手架。

felixrieseberg.en: Shifted to viewing AI as a background task handler, with the main gap being user understanding of AI's applicability.
felixrieseberg.zh: 转向将 AI 视为后台任务处理者，主要差距在于用户对 AI 适用性的理解。

felixrieseberg.en: Emphasized asynchronous interaction and judging by final impact, not close supervision, a change from earlier hands-on approach.
felixrieseberg.zh: 强调异步交互和以最终影响评判，而非密切监督，这与早期亲力亲为的方式不同。

felixrieseberg.en: Consistently valued AI's role in automating tasks, but evolved from tool-centric to user-centric, highlighting accessibility and creativity.
felixrieseberg.zh: 始终重视 AI 在自动化任务中的作用，但从以工具为中心演变为以用户为中心，强调可及性和创造力。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的恒定核心。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold but with diminishing returns; progress needs algorithmic innovation and new scaling axes like inference-time compute.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律仍然成立，但收益递减；进步需要算法创新和新的扩展轴，如推理时算力。

oriol.en: Post-training RL is a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math, despite lacking clean reward signals.
oriol.zh: 后训练强化学习是一个潜力巨大的新领域，超越编码和数学，尽管缺乏清晰的奖励信号。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; video's GPT moment has not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI 的核心路径；视频的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Agent memory will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates; continual learning is key.
oriol.zh: 智能体记忆将通过非参数的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新；持续学习是关键。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, making prefill cheaper than decode; models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽决定，使得预填充比解码更便宜；由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优。

reinerpope.en: Context length stagnation is due to memory wall, not compute limits; sparse attention reduces KV cache but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文长度停滞源于内存墙而非算力限制；稀疏注意力可减少 KV 缓存但有质量上限。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays reduce data movement by storing weights locally.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导计算成本；脉动阵列通过本地存储权重减少数据移动。

reinerpope.en: Quadratic scaling with bit width makes low precision far more efficient; FP4 throughput can be 3x FP8, not 2x.
reinerpope.zh: 位宽的二次方缩放使低精度效率远超预期；FP4 吞吐量可达 FP8 的 3 倍而非 2 倍。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together, not fundamentally different; deterministic latency in CPUs is possible but avoided due to market preferences.
reinerpope.zh: GPU 本质上是许多小型 TPU 拼接而成，并无根本差异；CPU 中确定性延迟可行但因市场偏好而被回避。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is outdated; trust intuition and craft over rigid steps.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年：传统设计流程已过时，应信任直觉与匠心，而非僵化步骤。

jennywen.en: Design process is dead; designers must build, ship fast, and adapt to 3-6 month horizons.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 3 月：设计流程已死；设计师需快速构建、交付，并适应 3-6 个月的前瞻周期。

jennywen.en: Embrace new archetypes like cracked new grads; speed and judgment outweigh taste.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 5 月：拥抱如“破解版新毕业生”等新原型；速度与判断力胜过品味。

lambert.en: RLHF is the most popular fine-tuning technique and will persist due to industry investment.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，RLHF 是最流行的微调技术，并将因行业投资而持续存在。

lambert.en: Post-training is an art: data quality matters more than algorithm choice, with SFT providing most gains.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，后训练是一门艺术：数据质量比算法选择更重要，SFT 贡献了大部分性能提升。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, enabling reasoning and tool use, but overoptimization is a risk.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，RLVR 是后训练领域最大的突破，实现了推理和工具使用，但存在过度优化的风险。

lambert.en: Open models will be the engine for AI research for the next decade, despite lagging 6-9 months behind closed models.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，开放模型将成为未来十年 AI 研究的引擎，尽管落后闭源模型 6-9 个月。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but gains now come from post-training and inference scaling; compute constraints widen US-China gap.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，预训练的缩放定律仍然成立，但收益主要来自后训练和推理扩展；算力限制拉大了中美差距。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件，扩展推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment helps mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，强调对齐紧迫性，迭代部署有助于缓解现实风险。

pachocki.en: Continual learning via scaling pre-training and RL is core; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，转向持续学习为核心，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现，思维链监控辅助对齐。

pachocki.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，预测模型将自主运行数天，需要新的监督范式。

pachocki.en: Biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，认为最大社会风险是少数人运营自动化组织导致权力集中。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training is key; curiosity-driven exploration prevents overfitting. Scaling curiosity to robots needs sample efficiency and cross-robot generalization.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，强调超越训练分布的泛化是智能关键，好奇心驱动的探索可防止过拟合。将好奇心扩展到机器人需样本效率和跨机器人泛化。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; no internet of robot data, so use all sources. A universal brain can power any robot, like ChatGPT for language.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，认为机器人学是数据问题，没有机器人数据的互联网，需利用所有数据源。通用大脑可赋能任何机器人，如同 ChatGPT 之于语言。

pathak.en: Deployment is primary challenge; cannot scale like software. Pretraining on diverse data and post-training on real-world data is key recipe.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，指出部署是首要挑战，无法像软件那样扩展。预训练多样数据、后训练真实数据是关键配方。

pathak.en: Video data alone insufficient; need simulation and real-world data. Data flywheel across verticals enables scaling from structured to unstructured.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，认为仅视频数据不足，需仿真和真实数据。跨垂直领域的数据飞轮实现从结构化到非结构化的扩展。

pathak.en: Unlike language models, robotics cannot achieve overnight success; deployment takes time. Middle-term home robot timeline highly uncertain.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，强调与语言模型不同，机器人无法一夜成功，部署需时间。家用机器人的中期时间线高度不确定。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）会产生涌现能力，如上下文内学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is future but must maintain entropy to avoid model collapse; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right for self-driving.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来，但需保持熵以避免模型崩溃；特斯拉的端到端方法对自动驾驶是正确的。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs are new operating systems; vibe coding democratizes programming, but agents need a decade of oversight.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：LLM 如同新操作系统；氛围编程使编程大众化，但智能体需要十年的监督。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; pre-training is crappy evolution, RL needs better credit assignment.
karpathy.zh: 我们召唤的是鬼魂，而非构建动物；预训练如同粗糙的进化，强化学习需要更好的信用分配。

karpathy.en: I haven't typed code since December; agents handle coding, bottleneck is directing them; agent-first tools are key.
karpathy.zh: 自去年十二月起我未再键入代码；智能体负责编码，瓶颈在于指挥它们；智能体优先的工具是关键。

kendall.en: Initially, end-to-end learning outperforms hand-coded stacks, but hybrid systems are worst; camera-only can reach human level, yet beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，认为端到端学习优于手工编码，混合系统最差；纯视觉可达人类水平，但超越人类安全需雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: World models and language integration enable reasoning, emergent safe behaviors, and introspection, shifting focus from hand-crafted rules to learned representations.
kendall.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，强调世界模型和语言整合带来推理、涌现安全行为和自省，从手工规则转向学习表征。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem; scaling generalizable AI requires massive data, compute, and world models for simulation, not new breakthroughs.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，明确自动驾驶本质是 AI 问题，规模化泛化 AI 需要海量数据、算力和世界模型模拟，而非新突破。

kendall.en: Mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; consumer vehicles are the near-term deployment path, not retrofits.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，主张内置传感器的量产车将超越 Robotaxi，消费车辆是近期部署路径，而非改装。

kendall.en: Safety is paramount; minimal risk maneuvers always provide a third option, making trolley problems theoretical; infrastructure and data quality trump algorithms.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，强调安全至上，最小风险操作总提供第三选项，电车难题是理论；基础设施和数据质量胜过算法。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, needing new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 至少还需十年以上；仅靠大语言模型可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress requires deep human evaluations with sophisticated evaluators.
edwinchen.zh: 像 Elo 这样的基准具有误导性且易被操纵；真正的进步需要由经验丰富的评估者进行深度人工评估。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实世界任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, shaping diverse AIs; eventually every company should train its own models.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室在目标函数上分化，塑造出多样化的 AI；最终每家公司都应训练自己的模型以契合自身理念。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate; human judgment is critical, and safety must prioritize avoiding omission harm.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 可能产生幻觉；人类判断至关重要，安全优先需避免因遗漏造成的伤害。

carlpei.en: Building a brand unites teams on a higher purpose; survival is core for startups.
carlpei.zh: 打造品牌能将团队凝聚在更高目标上；对初创公司而言，生存是核心。

carlpei.en: Smartphones' future lies in generative UI and proactive agents; hardware margins are low.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机的未来在于生成式界面和主动式智能体；硬件利润率低。

carlpei.en: AI models commoditize; open-source matches commercial, leading to price wars.
carlpei.zh: AI 模型商品化；开源媲美商业，导致价格战。
