carlpei.en: Design differentiates in mature categories; AI is an ingredient, not hype.
carlpei.zh: 在成熟品类中，设计是差异化关键；AI 是成分而非噱头。

carlpei.en: Smartphones won't be replaced by glasses; only brain-computer interfaces could.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机不会被眼镜取代；只有脑机接口可能做到。

turley.en: Model is product; iterate like software, ship daily to learn user needs.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他强调模型即产品，应像软件一样快速迭代、每日发布，以真实反馈驱动改进。

turley.en: Chat is not the future interface; it's like MS-DOS, UI will evolve.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他提出聊天并非终极界面，类比 MS-DOS，未来 UI 将超越逐轮对话。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated for frontier models.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他主张安全与产品速度分离，前沿模型需严格流程，产品开发则最大化加速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal and model gains.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他将北极星定为长期留存，增长源于消除摩擦、核心投资与模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他认为服务下十亿用户需主动、富交互的产品，而非简单聊天机器人。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems for broad impact, not narrow applications.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他认为 AI 在科学中应瞄准根节点问题以产生广泛影响，而非狭窄应用。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他提出将 LLM 的幻觉与真值检测器结合，可转化为创造性发现。

kohli.en: AI systems must be forced to generalize, not memorize, using hard evaluation metrics.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调用严格评估指标迫使 AI 泛化而非记忆，避免过拟合。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他认为后训练结合强化学习成为超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他坚持可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 式突破并非必需。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities, with diverse teams and video learning as key paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他强调 AI 应像显微镜一样增强人类能力，多元化团队和从视频学习是迈向 AGI 的关键路径。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogs in AI adoption, yet safety remains an open problem requiring global collaboration.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他指出非洲在 AI 应用上实现跨越式发展，但 AI 安全仍是开放问题，需全球协作。

nando.en: Consistently advocates for inclusive AI development, from diverse teams to African participation.
nando.zh: 始终倡导包容性 AI 发展，从多元化团队到非洲参与，一以贯之。

nando.en: Shifted from technical optimism about scaling to emphasizing responsible deployment and safety.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年对规模扩张的技术乐观，转向 2026 年强调负责任部署与安全，立场深化。

nando.en: Human skills like communication are as vital as coding, a new emphasis in later interviews.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他新增强调沟通等人文技能与编程同等重要，这是后期访谈的新重点。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence and solving onboarding.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文被低估了，上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能提升智能并解决上手问题。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning is a new scaling axis; verifiable rewards enable expert-level performance and new capabilities.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调强化学习是新的扩展轴，可验证奖励带来专家级表现和新能力。

sholto.en: Agent reliability over time horizon, not raw capability, is the key bottleneck; coding leads AI progress.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为智能体在时间跨度上的可靠性而非原始能力是关键瓶颈，编码引领 AI 进步。

sholto.en: AI progress is exponential; transformers suffice for AGI; no new architecture needed, just scaling and RL.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我坚信 AI 进步是指数级的，Transformer 足以实现 AGI，无需新架构，只需扩展和强化学习。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more; future work involves managing agent teams.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为能力过剩使得编排和工具更重要，未来工作是管理智能体团队。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI knowledge and reducing hallucinations; LLMs lack grounded experience.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，强调具身对于 AI 知识落地和减少幻觉至关重要，认为 LLM 因缺乏具身经验而产生幻觉。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning is best for low-level control, while LLMs handle high-level planning; RL is a cherry on top.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，提出强化学习适合底层控制，LLM 负责高层规划，强化学习只是锦上添花。

jimfan.en: Simulation and synthetic data are key for scaling embodied learning; real-world data is scarce.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 年到 2026 年，持续强调仿真和合成数据是扩展具身学习的关键，真实数据稀缺。

jimfan.en: Physical Turing test—robot cleaning messy house—is grand challenge; robots will outnumber iPhones by 2040.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，提出物理图灵测试（机器人整理凌乱房间）是具身 AI 的终极挑战，并预测机器人数量将在 2040 年超过 iPhone。

jimfan.en: System two reasoning progresses, but system one low-level control remains hardest; GPT-3 moment for robotics in ~5 years.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，认为系统二（推理）进展顺利，但系统一（底层控制）仍是具身 AI 最难部分；机器人领域的 GPT-3 时刻约在五年后出现。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling 可能无法解决常识问题；拥有更好数据和算法的小模型可以超越大模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我强调数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是内插人类知识，而非超越。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning requires careful engineering; RLVR can decrease pass@k even as best-of-n improves.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我指出强化学习需要精细工程；RLVR 可能降低 pass@k，即使 best-of-n 提升。

yejin.en: Small language models can be powerful with diverse synthetic data; pluralistic alignment respects diverse values.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我主张用多样化合成数据打造强大小模型；多元对齐尊重不同价值观。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning during pre-training improves reasoning by rewarding information gain, though computationally expensive.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我提出在预训练中引入强化学习，通过奖励信息增益提升推理，尽管计算成本高。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，主张设计师应会编程以建立同理心并加速交付；优先速度与熟悉感，而非追求完美。

henrymodisett.en: Brand is a strategic weapon for recruiting and differentiation; invest early to attract talent and stand out.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 年到 2026 年，始终强调品牌是招聘与差异化的战略武器，早期投入以吸引人才并脱颖而出。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; give designers ownership and autonomy to grow capability.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张招聘多元原型而非克隆；赋予设计师所有权与自主权以提升能力。

henrymodisett.en: Avoid rigid design crits; prefer organic feedback and gut decisions over data-driven processes in fast startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，认为在快速成长的初创公司中，应避免僵化的设计评审，偏好有机反馈和直觉决策而非数据驱动流程。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck them; AI is a creative partner for rapid experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 4 月，设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴，支持快速试错。

nadchishtie.en: Future design tools are interoperable with code as source of truth; legacy layers panel is outdated.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 4 月，未来设计工具以代码为源，互操作；传统图层面板已过时。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution with AI are most valuable; small teams outperform cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 12 月，用 AI 端到端执行的通才最有价值；小团队优于跨职能大组。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should show craft and intentionality, not process; side projects can outweigh experience.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 12 月，作品集重工艺与意图而非过程；副业可胜过正式经验。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting is like ignoring early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 12 月，核心流程用 AI 已成标配；不用如同忽视早期互联网。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict AI progress; test-time compute may surpass pre-training scaling.
truell.zh: 2024 年，认为缩放定律可预测 AI 进展，测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练缩放成为主要驱动力。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation better.
truell.zh: 2024 年，反共识：自然语言不会成为主要编程方式，示例和直接操作更优。

truell.en: Agents promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration central.
truell.zh: 2024 年，智能体有前景但尚不实用，迭代式人机协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Programming shifts to intent specification; taste and logic design valued over carefulness.
truell.zh: 2025 年，编程转向意图指定，品味和逻辑设计比细致更受重视。

truell.en: Custom models essential for product quality; every magic moment involves custom model.
truell.zh: 2025 年，定制模型对产品质量至关重要，Cursor 的每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

leike.en: AI safety needs empirical research; focus on alignment and robustness. PhD in ML is best path; talent gap exceeds funding gap.
leike.zh: 2018 年，强调 AI 安全需要实证研究，聚焦对齐与鲁棒性；读机器学习博士是成为安全研究员的最佳路径，人才缺口大于资金缺口。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability. Alignment may be easier than thought; train deceptive models as 'model organisms'.
leike.zh: 2023 年，认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督与可解释性；对齐可能比想象中容易，可故意训练欺骗性模型作为“模式生物”来研究。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone insufficient for AGI alignment. External oversight and third-party testing are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年，批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，仅靠后训练无法解决 AGI 对齐问题；强调外部监管与第三方测试的必要性。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hardware and software advances; self-play and imitation learning are key; RL lacks hierarchical reasoning for long horizons.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，认为机器人需要软硬件共同进步，自我对弈和模仿学习是关键，强化学习缺乏长时程分层推理。

abbeel.en: Combining unsupervised learning with RL boosts sample efficiency; avoid hard-coding priors; aim for 99.9% reliability in real-world robotics.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，强调无监督学习与强化学习结合提升样本效率，避免硬编码先验，追求真实世界机器人 99.9%的可靠性。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models transfer reasoning to non-language tasks, hinting at general intelligence; current AI still far from human generality.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，指出预训练语言模型可迁移推理到非语言任务，暗示通用智能，但当前 AI 远不及人类通用性。

shazeer.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction are AI-complete; scaling with compute and data yields intelligence, but internals remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为基于下一个词预测训练的大语言模型是 AI 完备的；通过算力和数据扩展能带来智能，但模型内部仍是炼金术般不可解。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term lever; models should learn by acting in the world, not just passive data.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他强调推理时算力扩展是近期关键杠杆，并主张模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非仅被动观察数据。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute drives progress but won't alone yield AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are essential.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年中，他认为测试时算力扩展能推动进步，但单靠它无法实现 AGI；智能体能力和强化学习至关重要。

shazeer.en: Consistently skeptical of hype (ARC, engagement metrics) and champions open-ended exploration and bottom-up innovation.
shazeer.zh: 他始终对炒作（如 ARC 基准、用户参与度指标）持怀疑态度，并倡导开放式探索和自下而上的创新。

shazeer.en: Shifted from viewing scaling as key to emphasizing algorithmic advances, inference scaling, and agentic learning for AGI.
shazeer.zh: 从 2023 年到 2025 年，他的观点从单纯强调规模扩展，转向重视算法进步、推理时扩展和智能体学习对实现 AGI 的作用。
